steps.say: A Signal Group turns several signals into one reading: | a score from minus one hundred to plus one hundred, and a label, such as Bullish.
You can start from a starter Group, the same ones behind the dashboard's pre-configured Trend, Stretch and Flow, | or from scratch. Let's build our own.
Add signals by dragging them in, or tapping plus. | Here: moving averages, the Ichimoku cloud, and the MACD line.
Each signal has a role. Score signals are combined into the Group's score. | Condition signals are only used in rules, and Context is shown alongside.
Rules give the labels, checked from the top: the first that matches wins. | At least plus thirty is Bullish. At most minus thirty is Bearish. Otherwise, Neutral.
If a rule can't be checked because a reading is missing, the label is Unknown, | never a guess.
Vetoes protect you from the wrong conditions. | Here, if the daily market is ranging, every label becomes Vetoed.
The checks tell you what blocks saving, and what is only a warning. | And the description is written for you, in plain words.
Name it, and save. It's yours, and private, until you publish it. | Changing it later saves a new version, so earlier ones stay as they were.
Why it helps: your reading of the trend, | the same every time, on every asset.
